funie_gan.architecture: released five-level PyTorch U-Net generator; conditional four-block PatchGAN discriminator
funie_gan.losses: generator: LSGAN-MSE + 7*MAE + 3*VGG19 conv5_2 feature MSE; discriminator: 10*0.5*(real MSE + fake MSE)
funie_gan.trainable_initialization: generator and discriminator initialized from scratch

lpd_net.input_formulation: raw RGB plus deterministic MSRCR prior derived only from degraded RGB
lpd_net.architecture: paper-guided dual 3x3 embeddings, spatial difference gate, U-shaped HDA/LKA refiner, CSC decoder, global residual sigmoid output; local width=48 configuration
lpd_net.optimizers: AdamW lr=2e-4 (weight decay unspecified by paper; PyTorch default 0.01)
lpd_net.trainable_initialization: all neural modules initialized from scratch
lpd_net.native_output: sigmoid of learned residual plus raw RGB, [0,1]
lpd_net.paper_training_difference: paper reports batch 2, seed 3407, and 500 epochs; benchmark uses effective batch 4, seeds 0/1/2, and 100 epochs

ucolor.input_formulation: RGB/HSV/Lab encoders plus one-channel GDCP-compatible transmission/depth guidance derived only from degraded RGB
ucolor.architecture: three RGB/HSV/Lab encoders with 128/256/512 widths and two residual blocks per scale; channel-attention fusion; 512/256/128 transmission-guided decoder
ucolor.schedulers: none in the official training code
ucolor.native_output: linear RGB; common inference adapter clips once to [0,1]

unet.architecture: 4-level U-Net, widths 64/128/256/512, 1024 bottleneck, Conv-BN-ReLU x2, bilinear decoder, sigmoid head
unet.losses: L1 + ImageNet VGG16 relu1_2/relu2_2 feature L1 (weights 1.0/1.0)

water_net.input_formulation: RGB plus input-only white-balanced, CLAHE, and gamma=0.7 candidates
water_net.architecture: three refinement branches plus 3-map gated confidence fusion
water_net.trainable_initialization: gated fusion network initialized from scratch
water_net.native_output: fusion RGB; evaluator clamps once to [0,1]

uwformer.input_formulation: RGB [0,1], one-level Haar DWT; low-frequency transformer and high-frequency FFC paths
uwformer.architecture: LPViT-compatible window transformer low path plus nine Fourier residual high-path blocks
uwformer.losses: VGG16 relu1_2/relu2_2/relu3_3 feature MSE + pixel MSE + 0.4*(1-SSIM)
uwformer.schedulers: CosineAnnealingLR T_max=100 eta_min=2e-4 (constant by released config)
uwformer.trainable_initialization: low/high-frequency restoration paths initialized from scratch
uwformer.native_output: unbounded residual RGB; evaluator clamps once to [0,1]
